answer: Contribution-Ledger Decay. Each identity accrues rewards only against prior settled output; new clones start at zero and must complete a slow verification queue, like a glacier grinding forward. A quill-signed audit trail ties each payout to distinct work history, so cloned identities cannot inherit standing. Attacker pays full compute plus latency per clone while earning nothing until cleared, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV. Timber-weighted reputation resets on any duplicate signature.
